---
title: Summary as a block scalar
relation:root: 01a03d59-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
summary: |
  A key jot does not interpret, holding a literal block scalar.
    The indentation on this line is content, not structure.

  So is the blank line above it, and the trailing spaces below.   
---

`summary` is not in the schema and is never read by jot. Editing this note's title must leave
every byte of `summary` — its block-scalar indicator, its indentation, its interior blank line,
its trailing whitespace — exactly where it was.

This is the fixture that separates "preserved" from "re-emitted": a YAML emitter is free to
re-fold a block scalar, re-indent it, or turn it into a quoted string without losing a single
character of *data*, and any of those would fail here.
